resources-article"><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-root markdown"><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h2"><h2 id="what-is-a-knowledge-based-agent" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-2">什么是基于知识的智能体？</h2></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">基于知识的智能体是一种利用知识库和推理引擎进行推理和行动的 AI 系统。知识库存储领域信息，推理引擎则将规则应用于已知事实并得出结论。它的基本流程是 <code>感知 → 知识库 → 推理 → 行动</code>。例如，一个技术支持智能体可以将打印机问题与故障排除规则相匹配，给出解决方案，并解释推荐依据。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h2"><h2 id="how-does-a-knowledge-based-agent-work" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-2">基于知识的智能体是如何工作的？</h2></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">AI 中基于知识的智能体通常遵循一个反复进行的推理循环：接收来自环境的信息，将其转化为结构化事实，然后查询知识库，最后选择相应或行动。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="the-perception-stage" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">感知阶段</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">感知阶段负责收集来自环境的信息，来源可以是用户消息、传感器读数、交易记录或系统事件。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">原始输入并不总是能直接用于逻辑推理，智能体可能需要先对输入进行归一化处理，识别关键实体、检测条件，并将结果转换为结构化的感知信息。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">例如：</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--code"><div class="resources-standard-code-block"><pre class="language-text"><code class="language-text">User input: The printer has power, but it does not print.
Percepts: printer_has_power, printer_not_printing</code></pre><div class="resources-standard-code-block-actions"><button type="button" class="resources-standard-code-block-copy" aria-label="Copy code"><span class="sr-only">Copy code</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">这种转换为推理引擎提供了统一的格式，便于进行规则匹配。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="the-tell–ask–perform-cycle" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">TELL–ASK–PERFORM 循环</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">典型的基于知识的智能体使用三种核心操作：</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--table"><div class="vp-doc-table-container kit-weaver-markdown-table-wrap"><div tabindex="0" class="vp-doc-table-wrapper"><table class="kit-weaver-markdown-table"><thead><tr><th class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-first-column-cell">操作</th><th class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-second-column-cell">作用</th><th class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell">示例</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-first-column-cell">TELL</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-second-column-cell">向知识库添加新信息</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell">记录某订单已延迟</td></tr><tr><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-first-column-cell">ASK</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-second-column-cell">查询知识库以获取结论</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell">检查该订单是否符合支持条件</td></tr><tr><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-first-column-cell">PERFORM</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-second-column-cell">执行所选行动</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell">发送物流跟踪更新</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div><div gap-3 justify-center"><a href="/" style="transition:transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), background-color 0.2s" class="jsx-4710ad66276b1735 vp-raw inline-flex h-10 w-fit items-center justify-center rounded-xl px-3 text-base font-medium  cta-button-primary-animated resources-cta-button resources-cta-button--primary min-w-14">体验 Kimi Agent<span class="inline-flex justify-center items-center w-5 h-5 shrink-0" style="opacity:0;width:0;margin-left:0;overflow:hidden;transition:opacity 0.2s, width 0.2s, margin-left 0.2s"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="17" height="11" viewBox="0 0 17 11" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="w-4 h-auto"><path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M16.282 5.894a.75.75 0 0 0-.002-1.059L11.665.22a.75.75 0 1 0-1.06 1.06l3.334 3.336H.75a.75.75 0 0 0 0 1.5h13.199l-3.347 3.37a.75.75 0 1 0 1.065 1.057z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></span></a></div></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="the-inference-and-action-stages" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">推理与行动阶段</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">推理引擎检查哪些规则与现有事实相匹配，并据此得出一个或多个结论。规划器或行动选择器可以利用这些结论来选择下一步。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">一个可靠的智能体应当区分已确认的结论和可能的解释。当知识库中信息不足时，智能体应请求澄清，或将该情况转交人工处理。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h2"><h2 id="what-are-the-main-components-of-a-knowledge-based-agent" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-2">基于知识的智能体主要由哪些部分组成？</h2></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">基于知识的智能体的架构由多个层次组成，每一层承担独立的职责。这种分层方式让系统更易于测试和维护。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="knowledge-base" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">知识库</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">知识库存储智能体用于推理的事实和规则。例如，它可以记录某位客户拥有有效订阅，而有效订阅用户可以使用某个特定的支持渠道。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">知识库可以使用数据库、知识图谱或规则引擎来实现，具体取决于应用领域。知识库的质量至关重要，因为信息缺失或错误都可能导致结论和操作不可靠。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="knowledge-representation" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">知识表示</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">知识表示定义了信息在系统内部的表达方式。命题逻辑处理简单的真假命题，而一阶逻辑使用变量和关系来表示更复杂的知识。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">其他方法包括 IF-THEN 生产规则，这类规则在专家系统中便于审查；本体用于定义领域概念及其相互关系，而知识图谱则利用这些关系连接实体。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="inference-engine" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">推理引擎</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">推理引擎将规则应用于知识库中的信息。正向链推理从已知事实出发，不断应用匹配的规则，直至得出结论。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">反向链推理从目标出发，反向查找支持该目标的事实。更高级的系统可能使用归结或统一等技术，来处理包含变量的逻辑语句。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="explanation-and-belief-revision" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">解释与信念修正</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">解释模块用于识别得出某个结论所依据的事实和规则。这条推理轨迹有助于用户理解智能体为何选择特定的答案或操作。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">信念修正用于处理知识库中的变化和冲突，它依据优先级策略判断哪些信息应保持有效，这在受监管的业务流程中尤为重要。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h2"><h2 id="where-are-knowledge-based-agents-used" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-2">基于知识的智能体应用于哪些场景？</h2></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">当系统需要遵循明确的领域知识时，基于知识的智能体十分有用，尤其适用于操作完成后需要对推理过程进行审查的场景。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="medical-decision-support" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">医疗决策支持</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">医疗决策支持系统可以将症状与临床规则进行比对，识别可能的病症，或建议下一步需要收集的信息。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">这类系统应当用于辅助医疗专业人员，而不是取代他们。其输出结果需要经过适当审核，尤其是在涉及患者护理决策的情况下。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="customer-support-automation" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">客户支持自动化</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">支持型智能体可以在回答客户问题之前先检索产品知识库，并利用业务规则判断该问题是否符合退款、升级处理或故障排查流程的条件。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">这一流程有助于保持回复的一致性，同时也让支持团队保留一份记录，说明某个操作被选择的原因。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="compliance-and-decision-support" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">合规与决策支持</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">合规系统可以将交易与内部政策进行核对，并标记出需要额外审批的情况。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">基于知识的系统在这类场景中很有用，因为政策可以表示为明确的规则。政策发生变化时，相关规则可以随之审查和更新。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="education-and-equipment-diagnosis" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">教育与设备诊断</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">智能辅导系统可以根据学生此前的答题情况，识别学习上的薄弱环节，进而选择合适的讲解内容或练习题。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">设备诊断系统可以结合传感器读数与维护规则，在满足特定条件时建议进行检查或创建维修工单。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h2"><h2 id="what-are-the-benefits-and-limitations" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-2">有哪些优势和局限性？</h2></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="benefits" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">优势</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">基于知识的智能体具备以下几个实用优势：</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><ul class="kit-weaver-markdown-list unordered"><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><strong>可解释性：</strong> 系统可以将结论与产生该结论的事实和规则联系起来。</p></li><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><strong>一致性：</strong> 同一规则可以在相似情况下以相同方式应用。</p></li><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><strong>领域专业性：</strong> 团队可以将特定行业的专业知识编码进系统。</p></li><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><strong>可维护性：</strong> 通常可以只更新某条规则，而不必重新训练整个模型。</p></li><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><strong>可审计性：</strong> 决策记录可以显示哪些信息影响了某个操作。</p></li><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><strong>目标导向推理：</strong> 智能体可以围绕明确的目标进行推理，而不是生成与目标无关的回应。</p></li></ul></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">这些优势使基于知识的智能体适用于流程明确的工作场景。当决策依赖于明确的规则时，它们对模型内部隐藏行为的依赖也更小。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="limitations" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">局限性</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">基于知识的智能体需要持续维护，才能保持准确和有效。构建知识库需要时间和领域专业知识，而信息过时或规则冲突都可能导致决策不可靠。因此，版本控制、定期审查以及明确的规则优先级都是必不可少的。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">传统规则系统也可能难以处理模糊、含噪声或超出领域范围的输入。随着知识库不断增长，推理成本会随之上升，因此需要精心设计索引和规则组织方式，才能维持系统性能。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h2"><h2 id="how-to-build-a-simple-knowledge-based-agent" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-2">如何构建一个简单的知识型智能体</h2></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">以下示例以 IT 支持场景为例，展示基本结构，但不将这个基于规则的原型当作生产系统使用。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="step-1-define-the-knowledge-base" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">第一步：定义知识库</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">从一个较窄领域的事实和规则开始：</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--code"><div><div class="resources-standard-code-block"><pre class="language-python"><code class="language-python">KNOWLEDGE_BASE <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token string">&quot;printer_has_power&quot;</span><span class="token punctuation">:</span> <span class="token boolean">True</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span>
    <span class="token string">&quot;printer_not_printing&quot;</span><span class="token punctuation">:</span> <span class="token boolean">True</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span>
    <span class="token string">&quot;print_queue_stuck&quot;</span><span class="token punctuation">:</span> <span class="token boolean">False</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span>
RULES <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token punctuation">[</span>
    <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
        <span class="token string">&quot;conditions&quot;</span><span class="token punctuation">:</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span><span class="token string">&quot;printer_has_power&quot;</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> <span class="token string">&quot;printer_not_printing&quot;</span><span class="token punctuation">}</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span>
        <span class="token string">&quot;conclusion&quot;</span><span class="token punctuation">:</span> <span class="token string">&quot;check_print_queue&quot;</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span>
    <span class="token punctuation">}</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span>
<span class="token punctuation">]</span></code></pre><div class="resources-standard-code-block-actions"><button type="button" class="resources-standard-code-block-copy" aria-label="Copy code"><span kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="step-2-convert-input-into-structured-facts" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">第二步：将输入转换为结构化事实</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">感知层负责将用户输入转换为事实。真实系统在这一步可能会用到自然语言处理技术。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">一个简单的原型可以从预定义输入开始：</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--code"><div><div class="resources-standard-code-block"><pre class="language-python"><code class="language-python">percepts <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="token string">&quot;printer_has_power&quot;</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span>
    <span class="token string">&quot;printer_not_printing&quot;</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span>
<span class="token punctuation">}</span></code></pre><div class="resources-standard-code-block-actions"><button type="button" class="resources-standard-code-block-copy" aria-label="Copy code"><span kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">推理引擎会检查某条规则的所有条件是否都已满足：</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--code"><div><div class="resources-standard-code-block"><pre class="language-python"><code class="language-python"><span class="token keyword">def</span> <span class="token function">infer</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span>percepts<span class="token punctuation">,</span> rules<span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">:</span>
    conclusions <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token punctuation">[</span><span class="token punctuation">]</span>
    <span class="token keyword">for</span> rule <span class="token keyword">in</span> rules<span class="token punctuation">:</span>
        <span class="token keyword">if</span> rule<span class="token punctuation">[</span><span class="token string">&quot;conditions&quot;</span><span class="token punctuation">]</span><span class="token punctuation">.</span>issubset<span class="token punctuation">(</span>percepts<span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">:</span>
            conclusions<span class="token punctuation">.</span>append<span class="token punctuation">(</span>rule<span class="token punctuation">[</span><span class="token string">&quot;conclusion&quot;</span><span class="token punctuation">]</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span>
    <span class="token keyword">return</span> conclusions</code></pre><div class="resources-standard-code-block-actions"><button type="button" class="resources-standard-code-block-copy" kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="step-4-select-an-action" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">第四步：选择行动</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">行动层负责将结论映射为响应：</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--code"><div><div class="resources-standard-code-block"><pre class="language-python"><code class="language-python"><span class="token keyword">def</span> <span class="token function">perform</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span>conclusions<span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">:</span>
    <span class="token keyword">if</span> <span class="token string">&quot;check_print_queue&quot;</span> <span class="token keyword">in</span> conclusions<span class="token punctuation">:</span>
        <span class="token keyword">return</span> <span class="token string">&quot;Open the print queue and remove any stuck job.&quot;</span>

class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">系统还可以记录匹配到的规则，从而生成一条基本的推理轨迹，供开发者或支持人员查看。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">这个示例展示的是一个最小化的知识型智能体。实际的更大规模实现还需要输入校验、规则优先级、知识版本管理、错误处理以及人工升级机制。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h2"><h2 id="meet-kimi-agent-turn-knowledge-into-finished-work" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-2">认识 Kimi Agent：把知识转化为可交付成果</h2></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">传统知识型智能体依赖明确的事实和规则。Kimi Agent 对知识密集型工作采用了更广泛、更现代的处理方式。只需给出预期结果，它就能规划任务，并借助内置工具完成所需步骤。你可以用它来研究某个主题、处理源材料，或生成可编辑的成果，而无需另外搭建一层任务编排系统。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="bring-your-source-knowledge-into-the-task" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">将源知识带入任务</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">一个有用的智能体需要获取正确的上下文信息。Kimi 支持上传最多 50 个文件，单个文件不超过 100 MB，支持 PDF 及常见办公文档格式。当任务需要更多上下文时，你还可以添加图片、TXT 文件或视频。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">这样一来，现有材料就能成为工作流程的一部分。例如，你可以让 Kimi Agent 分析一批报告，找出其中的重要发现，并将结果整理成一份清晰的文档。文件提供任务所需的具体知识，而你的提示词则定义了预期结果。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="turn-research-into-an-editable-deliverable" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">把研究成果变成可编辑的交付物</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">Kimi Agent 可以在多个产品界面中协同工作，因此结果不必止步于一段聊天回复：</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><ul class="kit-weaver-markdown-list unordered"><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">通过 <a href="/capabilities/ai-powered-research-assistant" target="_self">Kimi 深度研究</a> 生成带有支持来源的研究报告。</p></li><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">根据简短需求描述构建一个可用的<a href="https://www.kimi.ai/use-cases/mvp-builder" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">多页网站</a>。</p></li><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">根据源材料生成一份可编辑的 <a href="/capabilities/pdf-to-ppt" target="_self">PPT 演示文稿</a>。</p></li></ul></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">Kimi 还可以处理文档和电子表格相关的工作流程。这样一项任务就能从信息收集直接推进到可用的输出结果，而无需在不同工具之间来回搬运内容。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="scale-a-large-goal-with-kimi-agent-swarm" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">用 Kimi Agent Swarm 扩展大型目标</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">有些任务规模太大，单一的顺序工作流程难以胜任。Kimi Agent Swarm 可以将一个目标拆分给 300 多个子智能体处理，并支持最多 4,500 个并行工具调用。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">这种并行结构专为大规模搜索和长篇写作而设计，也可以支持那些若逐项处理会耗时更长的批量任务。各个子智能体分别处理目标的不同部分，而整体工作流程始终围绕最终目标展开。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--component kit-weaver-markdown-component--resource-ctabutton kit-weaver-markdown-tier--media"><div class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">AI 中的知识型智能体使用结构化知识对情境进行推理并选择行动。明确的规则让决策更容易解释和审查，其主要挑战来自知识维护、规则冲突以及输入不完整。现代系统可以将知识型推理与机器学习、RAG 和生成式 AI 结合起来。Kimi 为知识密集型工作流程提供了一个有价值的参考，而当决策必须遵循明确的领域规则时，传统知识型智能体依然具有重要价值。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--component kit-weaver-markdown-component--resource-ctabutton \",\"position\":{\"start\":{\"line\":5,\"column\":1,\"offset\":491},\"end\":{\"line\":5,\"column\":76,\"offset\":566}}},{\"type\":\"inlineCode\",\"value\":\"感知 → 知识库 → 推理 →
